identity.title: Pocket Monsters Special Scarlet Violet volume 1

leadText: Volume 1 is the first volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
plainText:
Volume 1 is the first volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
PASV01
PASV02 
PASV03
PASV04
PASV05 
PASV06

 

==Trivia==
Initially, the Japanese cover of this volume would use another color palette, but according to author Satoshi Yamamoto, to avoid comparisons with Courage! Friendship! New Three Musketeers (another manga series by the same author), he decided to change it before the final publication.
